clicks:
1. Nothing to press: the day after a new joiner starts, their joining checklist opens a goal sheet for them with two weeks to write it, and emails them.
2. To see it from the employee side, sign in as the employee.
3. Click the search bar at the top of the screen (or press Ctrl+K / ⌘K), type “My goals” and choose “My goals”. (or go to payobook.com/my and open “My goals”).
4. The page shows the date the goals are due.
5. HR can also open the year for everybody at once: “People” → “Goals” tab → “Open it for everyone” (the HR lead only).
comments: Reminders go 3 days before the due date, 1 day before, on the day, and every 3 days after. Joiners who started before this was switched on keep their old checklist. The two-week period is a setting.

clicks:
1. Sign in.
2. Click the search bar at the top of the screen (or press Ctrl+K / ⌘K), type “My goals” and choose “My goals”. (or go to payobook.com/my and open “My goals”).
3. Under “Start from one of these”, press “Use this one” on a template, or open “Write a goal”.
4. Fill in “What you are going to do”, “Why it matters and what good looks like”, “Done by”, the key results and “How you think it will go”, then press “Add it”.
5. Move a key result with “Where it is now” / “How far along” and press “Save”.
6. Press “Send them to …” (your manager).
comments: The page will not send until each goal has its title, dates and key results. Templates are written by HR for a job. Each key result has its own progress figure.

clicks:
1. Sign in.
2. In the left menu click “Home”, then the “Approvals” tab.
3. Open “Goals · Quách Anh Tuấn · DEMO Goal year 2026”.
4. To set the weights: Click the search bar at the top of the screen (or press Ctrl+K / ⌘K), type “Goals” and choose “Goals”., open Quách Anh Tuấn’s sheet, type a weight for each goal (out of 100) and press “Save the weights”.
5. Press “Send it back” to ask for edits (with a note), or “Approve” in Approvals to agree it. It then goes to the HR lead to lock.
comments: The weights must add up to 100 before the sheet can be agreed. A manager who has not decided within the set time is reminded, and after that the HR lead is told.

clicks:
1. Sign in as the HR lead (demo.hr@example.com).
2. In the left menu click “People”.
3. Open the “Goals” tab.
4. Click the “With the HR lead” step to list sheets waiting for the lock.
5. Open one and agree it in “Home” → “Approvals” (“Approve”) — the sheet becomes “Agreed and locked”.
6. To see a locked one, open Thái Ngọc Diệp’s sheet: it shows when it was locked and by whom.
comments: Once locked, the goals cannot be changed except through a change request. The lock date, who locked it, and the history are kept on the sheet.

clicks:
1. Sign in.
2. Click the search bar at the top of the screen (or press Ctrl+K / ⌘K), type “Goals” and choose “Goals”..
3. Open Thái Ngọc Diệp’s sheet (agreed and locked).
4. See each goal’s weight, and mark each key result out of 5, then press “Save the scores”.

comments: A goal’s score is the average of its key results; the year is the goals weighted by their weights. No total shows until every mark is in. The band words and cut-offs are settings.
